summary: Completed comprehensive testing of ZeroTier Network Guard feature. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend tests verified ZT Guard panel in Account Security page and login error message display when guard blocks network admin login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ZT Guard is currently DISABLED. The guard has fake network_id ('test-network-fake') and fake api_token from testing. When enabled with this fake config, the ZeroTier API call will fail and login will be blocked for network admins (this is expected strict behavior).

GET /api/auth/zt-guard/config.details: Returns ZT Guard config for system admins, returns 403 for non-system admins

PUT /api/auth/zt-guard/config.details: Updates ZT Guard config (enabled, network_id, api_token)

POST /api/auth/zt-guard/test.details: Tests ZT Guard with current request IP, returns client_ip, allowed, reason

login_guard_disabled.details: Network admin (yannick) can login successfully when guard is disabled

login_guard_enabled_blocked.details: Network admin is BLOCKED with 403 when guard is enabled with fake network

login_system_admin_bypass.details: System admin can still login when guard is enabled (exempt from guard)

cli_zt_guard_enable.details: Fails if no network configured, succeeds if network is configured

cli_zt_guard_set.details: Validates and sets network config, returns error for invalid token/network

frontend_zt_guard_panel.details: Account Security page shows ZT Guard panel for system admin with toggle, network_id input, api_token input, and save button

frontend_login_error_message.details: Login error toast shows 'ZeroTier network verification failed. Service unavailable.' when guard blocks login

zt_guard_behavior.exempt: System admins bypass the check entirely
zt_guard_behavior.strict_mode: If ZeroTier API is unreachable, login is blocked
verification_methods: Physical address (public IP the member connects from)
